_comment: Promotion quests are class-gated and data-driven. defeat_enemy objective behaviour is implemented once by QuestManager; quest-specific ids and values live only here.

quests.name: Trial of the Dawn
quests.description: Face the darkness beneath the shrine and return with your oath intact.

quests.name: The Silent Contract
quests.description: Prove that even the shrine's unseen warden can be reached.

quests.name: The Unwritten Page
quests.description: Defeat the keeper below the shrine and record what waits beyond it.

quests.name: The Last Bastion
quests.description: Break the shrine's guardian twice and show that endurance can become victory.

quests.name: The Moonless Night
quests.description: Hunt the thing below the shrine until the dark itself learns caution.

quests.name: The Hollow Crown
quests.description: Unmake the shrine's warden twice and claim authority over what remains.

quests.name: The Final Oath
quests.description: Return to the deepest dark three times. Let each victory renew the vow.

quests.name: The Devouring Dark
quests.description: Feed the dark its own guardian until nothing remains but your shadow.

quests.name: The First Word
quests.description: Silence the shrine's answer three times and speak the word that remains.

quests.name: Ascension
quests.description: Overcome the last guardian five times. There is no witness left to name what follows.

quests.name: Roots That Remember
quests.description: Lethira asks you to cut silver thorns from the stalkers haunting her lost path.

quests.name: A Memory With Wings
quests.description: With Lethira beside you, follow the cold lanterns carrying pieces of her past.

quests.name: The Missing Resonance
quests.description: Brokk needs intact crystal shells to reconstruct an erased clan refrain.

quests.name: Where the Deep Song Broke
quests.description: Descend with Brokk and confront the delvers repeating his clan's stolen verse.

quests.name: A Debt Written in Briars
quests.description: Veyra's infernal creditor has hidden clauses inside the witches' living marks.

quests.name: No Signature Remains
quests.description: Veyra asks you to erase the acolytes still enforcing contracts in her name.

quests.name: The Oath's Missing Verbs
quests.description: Rhazek believes thunder drake scales preserve the burned words of his family oath.

quests.name: First Light, Last Guardian
quests.description: Carry Rhazek's restored oath into the cloud ruins and silence its ancient witnesses.

quests.name: A Practical Education
quests.description: Mara asks for proof that heroism includes listening, travelling, and carrying things.

quests.name: The Many Roads
quests.description: A human traveller asks you to deliver letters to three settlements, proving that humans belong everywhere.

quests.name: Songs of the Silver Wood
quests.description: Elder Amariel asks you to recover three lost elven songs from the depths of Mosswood.

quests.name: The Deep Roads
quests.description: Thane Dorrim sends you into the crystal mines to reopen a collapsed tunnel and recover a lost clan relic.

quests.name: The First Oath
quests.description: Keth Cloudscar asks you to honour the first dragonkin oath by defeating a thunder drake at the Obsidian Gate.

quests.name: The Ash Court Summons
quests.description: Mother Sable delivers a summons from the Ash Court. You must prove your worth or face the consequences.

quests.name: The Great Migration
quests.description: Siv Quickpaw asks you to scout the migration route and clear the path of threats.

quests.name: The Blood Debt
quests.description: Gruk Ironjaw tells you of a blood debt owed to his clan. You must defeat the bandits who wronged them.

quests.name: The War Song
quests.description: An orc elder asks you to prove your strength in the arena, earning the right to sing the war song.

quests.name: The Grand Invention
quests.description: Pip Sprocket needs rare components for a device that will revolutionise travel. Gather the parts!

quests.name: Controlled Demolition
quests.description: Pip's latest invention has gone haywire in the mines. Shut it down before it brings the ceiling down!

quests.name: The Great Pie Contest
quests.description: Rose Underhill challenges you to gather the finest ingredients for the annual halfling pie contest.

quests.name: The Uninvited Guest
quests.description: A halfling thief has stolen from the community. Track them down and recover the goods.

quests.name: Elemental Heritage
quests.description: Ember Skysong asks you to commune with the elemental planes at four sacred sites.

quests.name: The Storm Calling
quests.description: A genasi elder asks you to calm a raging elemental storm threatening Skyreach.

quests.name: The Mountain's Test
quests.description: Korrath Peaks challenges you to survive the mountain's trials — a test of endurance and will.

quests.name: The Reckoning
quests.description: Among goliaths, every deed is scored. Prove your worth by defeating the strongest foes in the land.

quests.name: The Lost Library
quests.description: Sythia Coils asks you to recover three ancient tomes from the Drowned Archive.

quests.name: The Serpent's Memory
quests.description: An ancient lamia asks you to visit the places where her kind once ruled, recovering lost history.

quests.name: Threads of Fate
quests.description: Nethys Websong asks you to gather silk from three ancient spider nests to weave a tapestry of prophecy.

quests.name: The Great Hunt
quests.description: An arachne elder challenges you to prove your hunting prowess by defeating the most dangerous prey.

quests.name: Welcome to Ironveil
quests.description: Commander Vex wants to test your worth before granting access to the city's inner sanctum.

quests.name: The Ashen Expedition
quests.description: Chronicler Thon needs someone to recover artifacts from the Ashen Wastes before they're lost forever.

quests.name: Heart of Cinder
quests.description: Artificer Zara needs a core sample from the deepest magma flow to power her latest invention.

quests.name: The Void Throne
quests.description: Commander Vex is assembling a strike force to assault the Void Throne. You are the tip of the spear.

quests.name: Secrets of the Sunken Citadel
quests.description: Chronicler Thon believes the Sunken Citadel holds records of the first war against the void.

quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Shadow Reaver to Void Reaver by defeating the guardians of ascension.
